posts.title: Duolingo Day 151 - Features and Tanking Motivation
posts.description: Learning Italian has really slowed down for me. On Duolingo, I've hit day 151, but my motivation to learn more is tanking and I am moving at a glacial pace. Since it's colder, I find less opportunities to chat with my neighbors outside. Most of them usually just switch to English right away, since it's easier to communicate. posts.title: Halloween Parkrun and Bike Trainer
posts.description: The last Parkrun in October fell on Halloween. So naturally, I dressed up as a green monster and went for a run. Good thing it was a cool day, because it was quite warm trying to run in a onesie. Several people also came in costume and we got to get picture together - my wife dressed up as a blue monster. posts.title: October Hobby Update
posts.description: Now that it’s October, triathlon season has come to a stop. Although warmer than usual in Toronto, I have stopped swimming outdoors and cycling with my group. I still try to run two times a week and go to Parkrun on Saturdays. More time indoors means more time for other hobbies like language learning, baking and coffee!
